data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Barry Van Tassell and Shaurjo Biswas that has raised $38.9M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though a formal peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage matches within narrow valuation tiers.

The analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $39M total capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $78M. The peer universe includes well-capitalized companies such as Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen, providing sector context but insufficient clustering for direct statistical comparison. A peer-median approach was not applicable given the absence of three or more directly comparable datapoints at matching stage and valuation tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $66M to $89M, with a median point of $78M. This range reflects the stage-progression methodology and incorporates conservative and upside variants around the single applicable triangulation method. Key uncertainties include the absence of a robust peer-median cross-check and the reliance on capital raised as a valuation proxy rather than revenue or profitability metrics. Additional clarity on company-specific unit economics, technology differentiation, and near-term revenue trajectory would strengthen confidence in this range.
